title: Moffatt-Ladd House Museum

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Host your next celebration in one of Portsmouth’s most distinctive settings. From intimate dinners to large-scale celebrations, the Moffatt-Ladd House & Garden Museum offers a timeless backdrop where history, gardens, and architecture come together to create truly memorable events. Elegant, seasonal, and perfect for open-air gatherings among historic landscaping. Ideal for receptions, ceremonies, and cocktail-style events. A flexible, covered space blending historic character with modern functionality-perfect for larger groups, dining setups, and weather-proof planning. We partner with some of Portsmouth’s best vendors to ensure a seamless experience. We especially recommend nearby catering

blurb: The Moffatt-Ladd House and Garden Museum is a visit worth taking. It has been meticulously restored and maintained since 1912 by the National Society of Colonial Dames of America-New Hampshire (NSDCA-NH), a women's organization founded in 1891. Delve into the captivating narrative of 5 generations from pre-revolution to today, each chapter woven with resilience, heritage, and evolution.
